messages:
maria: Heads-up: console invoice-preview for a handful of heavy tenants is showing lower token counts compared to tally. Pattern seems correlated with requests routed via the 'burst' policy since ~0300UTC.

sam: saw that too. quick grep shows enricher patch pr-6302 in canary might be dropping non-standard headers. could be losing x-route-priority.

leo: ran a live trace for tenant=acct-77: edge->enricher->collector. edge has header x-route-priority:burst, enricher emits enrichment JSON without route_priority. sample: EDGE_HEADERS:{x-route-priority:burst} -> ENRICH_PAYLOAD:{attrs:{session: s1, model: gemini}} (no priority)

ash: that PR intentionally filtered unknown headers to reduce side-channel noise. oops. we didn't account for downstream billing clients relying on that.

metering-bot: ALERT preview-vs-tally delta detected tenant=acct-77 delta=22% window=3h sample_events=1420

maria: mitigation options: 1) revert PR in canary 2) change enricher to forward a compact map raw_route_attrs 3) change collector to reconstruct priority from other attrs (riskier). prefer #2 short-term.

sam: agree. forwarding raw_route_attrs behind a feature-flag seems lowest blast radius. I'll draft a small change: add field `raw_route_attrs_v1` and flag `forward_route_attrs`.

leo: note: Tally batching normalizes attributes per batch key. if we add raw_route_attrs we must ensure the batch key includes route_priority so counts don't collapse across priorities. I'll add unit tests for batch index composition.

devex: Console: preview currently groups by route_priority; if that field disappears previews will look different. We should add a fallback that uses raw_route_attrs to display a best-effort grouping and show a small banner "computed from raw attrs". Also expose a new telemetry card `preview_tally_delta_pct` per tenant.

maria: agreed. also we need to avoid double accounting: if collector reconstructs priority and preview reconstructs differently, customers may be confused. Tally must be authoritative.

sam: deployment plan: land enricher change in canary with flag off, dark launch for 20% with flag on, run shadow tally, then open for broader rollout if deltas < 1%. If delta stays large, rollback PR-6302 in canary.

ash: patch ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/enricher/pulls/6310 adds raw_route_attrs_v1 + preserve_unknown_headers flag. tests included.

leo: added TestBatchKeyIncludesRoutePriority and TestDedupeRequiresSessionId for burst logic. found a dedupe edge: when session_id missing, events collapsed across burst priority which undercounts preview. proposed fix: only dedupe when session_id present for burst.

devex: UI folks will add preview-diff column in invoice-preview and an opt-in toggle in Console settings for "Preview parity with tally". design in #console-design.

metering-bot: TASK created BI-1005 assignee=sam due=2025-03-04T18:00:00Z

maria: action items: sam -> enable forward_route_attrs flag in canary dark launch + shadow tally (ETA tomorrow), leo -> land batch and dedupe tests, ash -> coordinate canary revert window if needed, devex -> implement preview fallback and telemetry card. I'll prepare a short customer comms draft if previews drift.

sam: starting dark launch now for 20% traffic. will monitor `preview_tally_delta_pct` and post updates here.

leo: landed batch fixes in test branch. pushing to staging.

ash: canary patch queued. If we see >5% delta after 2h we rollback.

maria: thanks. please attach shadow tally output here once 24h completes.
